entries.title: Psalms 46:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song for Alamoth.>> God [is] our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 46:2
segments: Therefore we will not fear, Even though the earth be removed, And though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 46:3
segments: [Though] its waters roar [and] be troubled, [Though] the mountains shake with its swelling. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 46:4
segments: [There is] a river whose streams shall make glad the city of God, The holy [place] of the tabernacle of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 46:5
segments: God [is] in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, just at the break of dawn.

entries.title: Psalms 46:6
segments: ¶The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

entries.title: Psalms 46:7
segments: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; The God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 46:8
segments: Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who has made desolations in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 46:9
segments: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth; He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two; He burns the chariot in the fire.

entries.title: Psalms 46:10
segments: Be still, and know that I [am] God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth!

entries.title: Psalms 46:11
segments: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; The God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah
